gcm.purpose: Redesign MediaForge around simple task-first workflows while preserving advanced tools.
changeNotes: Adds a What do you want to do today? home with Rename, Website Preparation, Unknown Image Identification, Analyze My Files, and Catalog & Settings.
Adds direct ZIP/image intake for the simple Rename and Website Preparation workflows.
Moves naming recipe controls behind Advanced settings while preserving existing presets and preview/export behavior.
Routes MediaForge navigation into the GCM OS GitHub Pages subdirectory instead of the retired standalone Cloudflare Pages project.
